name: Northern Leopard Frog
desc: Northern Leopard Frog (Lithobates pipiens): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 51 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lithobates pipiens formerly Rana pipiens, commonly known as the northern leopard frog, is a species of leopard frog from the true frog family, native to parts of Canada and the United States.
